result:
I created `CLAUDE.md` in the repo root. I haven't run any of the commands in it, so none are tested.

It covers:
- **Commands:** how to run all tests, one test class and one test method, plus the demo. The `pom.xml` has no exec plugin, so the demo command in the file needs full plugin coordinates. Running `DemoScenario.main` from the IDE is simpler.
- **Architecture:** how the code splits into `Database`, `DataStore`, the services and the model records. `DataStore` is one 10k-line class holding all the SQL. I also noted that `schema.sql` is split on `;`, so a statement can't contain a literal semicolon.
- **Adding a feature:** a new feature usually touches the schema, a model record, `DataStore`, a service and a test.
- **Tests:** each test builds its own in-memory database and compares money with `compareTo`.

The repo has no README, Cursor or Copilot rules, or Codex/Gemini config, so there was nothing to import.
